title: Kagamine Rin — Bringing The Fun And Games♪〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Our party was a huge success!
I had so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm so glad Ichika and the others seemed like they had a ton of fun.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Me too! None of this would've been possible without you, Len!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, raise your right hand for me!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: My right hand? Sure.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Here's to our success... High five☆

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Nice work, you two.
That was such a wonderful party.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And the girls seemed to really enjoy themselves.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe! I also need to thank you and the others for helping us out with it, MEIKO! You guys ended up being lifesavers!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We're glad that we could help.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Anyway, we've still got one thing left to do for the party, so let's get to it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Right! Our party isn't over yet...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It's cleanup time☆

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
The paper cups go in the bin!
The chip bags also go in the bin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
And the chocolate wrappers...
Oh, nice☆ There's still one left!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (I think these are the ones that Sakki said were really good. I'll give it to her the next time she visits!)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hey, Rin, don't stop cleaning.
This isn't snacktime.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I am cleaning!
If anything, aren't you dragging your feet a bit?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, it looks like Ichika and the others already put the deck of cards back together.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hey, you're right.
In that case, all we have to do is put it back in its case!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Still, that game of Old Maid we played was so much fun! Everyone loved doing impressions of each other♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Honami's impression of Ichika was remarkably good...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It was Ichi eating something really yummy, right? It had to have been a yakisoba bun! I know it!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And we had a lot of fun blowing up these balloons yesterday too, didn't we!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, we did quite a lot with them, including that contest to see who could exhale the longest.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
All of us put up a good fight.
We should do that with Ichika and the others next time.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, that'd be great!
I'll add it to the list of possible events for next time!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It sounds like you're concocting another weird plan...
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow, this place is so much cleaner now! It really goes fast with everyone working together.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: All that's left are the decorations on the blackboard. Once those are down, this classroom will be all back to normal...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's a little sad, when it was so lively not too long ago.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, I know what you mean.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
But cleaning up has also been plenty fun!
I mean, we've had a chance to think about everything we did together...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Plus, cleaning up feels like a big game where we're trying to complete missions♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Missions?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! For example... The ten-second blackboard challenge!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: The what?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You have ten seconds to make the blackboard spotless! If you succeed, then you get to give yourself a pat on the back♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Lemme give it a try!
Here I go...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: *Roar*

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's our Rin. She's always got a way to make everything fun.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. Why don't we complete these cleanup missions together?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, the more the merrier!
That includes you guys, Len!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Ready, you guys?
Here we go!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Our mission is to clean up the classroom! Let's get started!
